g.text: ArthurRank6Convo3 begins.
I found myself having a conversation with the guitar the other day.
I'm not a huge fan, personally.
Lizzie? How'd that go?
Honestly, I rather like her. Once you get past the... oddness... of it?
Better than I would have thought. I rather like her.
Besides,
Since she and Eleanor seem to always be laughing at jokes that no one else can hear.
I figured I ought to go introduce myself properly.
She has a lot of useful insights. And Flare is lovely. Honestly, that whole pack in the bar is a breath of fresh air.
Well. Proverbially.
Sick of the Hex already?
What insights did she have?
I'm glad you're making friends. lol.
What? No! Of course not.
Fascinating ones, regarding how many times the year has looped.
I suppose it's just nice to have some folks around to talk to that I haven't been through so much with.
The Hex are my family. My team. You know that.
How many times I may or may not have forgotten years past. How she lives... outside of time? And how we do not.
I'm not sure if that makes any sense at all. I know them, I trust them, I just haven't *been through hell and back* with them.
And before you say anything, no. I don't want to know. It isn't my right to know.
So it makes it easier sometimes to just sit and drink with them.
I guess I just want to say - whether you have or not? It's okay. I won't hold it against you.
I've never really had that option.
Yeah. I get that.
It also helps that some of them are a bit older and have military experience.
This situation we're in? It isn't normal. We weren't meant for things like this - humans, I mean.
I suppose not.
There isn't so much... weight. So much past. Amir would call it baggage.
Sol. Does it ever. Wasn't sure what to make of the Libertatians at first. But now? Quite glad they're here.
There aren't guidebooks for this. Whatever you choose to do, I trust you to have good reasons to do it.
But it all got me thinking.
Check boolean ArthurDating
Uh oh.
About what?
I love you. And even if I forget that? Even if you choose to go another way? That's all right.
true
I trust you with my life. And nothing is going to change that. Even if I forget it for a little while.
false
Heh. Hear me out. This is about you, though.
You.
Before you came here, I don't think I could have accepted that. I would have been too afraid to lose you. To lose this.
Before you came here, I don't think I could have accepted that. I would have been too afraid to lose some part of myself.
And this whole... looping timeline. And it's got me thinking about how many 1999s I might not remember.
I would have clung to it like a desperate man clinging to a raft at sea. But maybe I've been in this loop enough times now, or... maybe it's just you, I don't know.
Whatever the guitar has told you is slander, I swear.
Am I in trouble?
I... don't think we should get into this, Arthur.
This happiness you've given me now - this peace - is worth more in this moment than knowing it might last forever.
Just wait a second, will you? You know I type slower than you do.
If there's one thing in life you learn as a soldier, it's that everything is fleeting.
What I'm trying to say is this:
Here one second, gone the next. I guess I've just come to accept that. Once and for all.
Whether or not you've made me, or the rest of the Hex, forget our past interactions? It's okay.
So, whether our time together ends because you punch the floor and I forget everything?
I won't hold it against you.
Or because the Indifference catches you off guard some day?
I'm going to enjoy this moment that I have. Here and now. Because it's what I've got.
And that's what I know I can be sure of.
It's nothing personal. It's mostly because I keep screwing up trying to date your sister. :P
Thanks, Arthur... that means more to me than I think I can really express.
I wish I had your kind of level-headedness, sometimes. <3
Har har. Well, it's a good thing you have a magical super power that allows you to remove your foot from where you've lodged it so spectacularly down your trachea, isn't it?
Every now and then, I try to pull the stick out of my arse long enough to say something meaningful.
It's more because I know I functionally have no other choice but to keep a stiff upper lip. Such is the Britannic way.
The rest of us just have to learn how to communicate. Question, though.
Well, I think it's time for a drink. Shall we?
Like the old saying goes. "Keep Composed and Continue Forward."
Does she lower her standards with every reset?
Maybe later.
Meet you there. :)
Chat ends.
Suit yourself.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
